title: flow.list2many
description: `flow.list2many` routes each element of an incoming list to the corresponding outlet, prepending the selector assigned to that position. Provide the selectors as creation arguments; for example, `flow.list2many @a @b @c` turns `1 2 3` into the messages `@a 1`, `@b 2`, and `@c 3` at its respective outlets.
